meta.title: Try to purchase a dormant-locked PR line
gaps: Select specifically the dormant-locked PR line identified by its lock icon rather than the first available PR row
Unlock or request to unlock the dormant PR line and verify "Unlock request sent successfully"
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Select specifically the dormant-locked PR line identified by its lock icon rather than the first available PR row; Unlock or request to unlock the dormant PR line and verify "Unlock request sent successfully"

steps.note: Enable the dormant-lock rule required by the case.
Open the Purchase Requisitions screen, the required entry point for PR sourcing.
Ensure only open requisitions eligible for sourcing are shown.
Select the closest available PR row; the catalog cannot identify the dormant lock icon directly.
Verify that sourcing remains disabled after the PR selection.
Hover the disabled Purchase Items control to reveal its reason.

args.text: Dormant locked PR cannot be purchased

steps.note: Confirm that clicking the disabled Purchase Items control is refused.
